deferred.claim: Cast Hearth Elemental with its graveyard-based cost reduction, counting each instant, sorcery, or card with an Adventure once.
deferred.basis: This spell costs {X} less to cast, where X is the number of cards in your graveyard that are instant cards, sorcery cards, and/or have an Adventure.

deferred.claim: Cast Stoke Genius to discard your hand, then draw two cards.
deferred.basis: Discard your hand, then draw two cards. (Then exile this card. You may cast the creature later from exile.)
